title: Policy Service Note: HomeGuard Refunds and Mortgagee Records
content:
A credit balance on a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy is refunded only when it reaches the package's refund minimum, and mortgagee details are recorded only as the mortgage statement shows them. Both rules are set out below.

## Refunds of a credit balance

A refund is issued only when the policy's premium balance is a credit of at least the package's refund minimum. The premium balance is the policy's premium account as recorded; a negative balance is a credit owed back to the payer.

A smaller credit stays on the account and is applied to the next bill, or is written off when the policy has ended.

The refund goes to the payer of the most recent payment:

| Most recent payment made by | Refund sent |
|---|---|
| The mortgagee | To the mortgagee, by check |
| The named insured, by EFT | Back to the bank account |
| The named insured, by card | Back to the card |
| The named insured, by check | By check |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical).* With a refund minimum of 5.00 USD: a credit of 5.00 USD is refunded; a credit of 4.99 USD on a live policy stays on the account for the next bill, and on an ended policy is written off.

## Mortgagee records

- A mortgagee change is recorded only with both the new mortgagee's name and the loan number exactly as they appear on the mortgage statement. These details come from the named insured's mortgage statement; a change missing either detail is not recorded.
- On a loan payoff both the mortgagee name and the loan number are cleared, and a policy billed to the mortgagee's escrow moves to a direct billing plan at the next renewal.
- The mortgagee receives the package's mortgagee notice days of advance notice of any cancellation.
- For a mortgagee-billed policy, the mortgagee is invoiced for each term when installment 1 of that term is billed.
